blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Generative Artificial Intelligence is transforming the role of natural language in computational systems. In classical Natural Language Processing (NLP), language was treated as an object of computation: something to analyse, classify, translate, or generate. Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge this perspective, enabling natural language to function increasingly as an executable cognitive medium through which humans structure reasoning, orchestrate problem solving, and regulate hybrid human/AI workflows.
  This paper introduces Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical and epistemological extension of traditional NLP. Rather than focusing on language understanding alone, NLPg conceptualises prompts as dynamic cognitive artefacts that externalise goals, constraints, assumptions, validation criteria, and intermediate reasoning states. Prompting is thus not merely a technical interaction technique, but a form of dialogic cognitive programming operating within distributed human/AI memory architectures.
  Building on theories of distributed cognition, extended mind, metacognition, and dialogic learning, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory, describing how prompts and conversational states function as temporary external memory structures supporting reasoning continuity and reflective regulation. We further map existing memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto this framework, illustrating how episodic, semantic, and metacognitive layers support long-horizon conversational coherence.
  Finally, implications for computational linguistics and AI/mediated knowledge systems are discussed, suggesting a post symbolic and post interface paradigm in which natural language operates simultaneously as communication medium, executable specification, cognitive scaffold, and distributed memory architecture.
blocks.zh:
遗传人工 智能正在改变自然语言在计算系统中的作用. 在古典自然语言处理(NLP)中,语言被当作一个计算对象:分析,分类,翻译,或生成的东西. 大语言模型(LLMs)挑战了这一视角,使自然语言越来越能发挥可执行的认知介质的作用,人类通过它来构建推理,协调解决问题,并规范人类/AI混合工作流程.
本文将"自然语言编程"(NLPg)作为传统"自然语言编程"(NLP)的理论和认知延伸. NLPg概念不只注重语言理解,而是催生出能将目标、限制、假设、验证标准和中间推理状态外部化的动态认知手工艺品。 因此,促动不仅仅是一种技术交互技术,而是在分布的人类/AI记忆架构中运行的一种对话认知编程形式.
论文以分布式认知,扩展心智,元认知,和对话式学习等理论为基础,提出了"对谈工作记忆"的概念,描述了即时和对话状态如何作为支持推理连续性和反射调节的临时外存结构发挥作用. 我们进一步将现有的内存结构(BTMA, SKGE, RMR)映射到这个框架上,以说明史诗,语义,和元认知层如何支持长相间的对话一致性.
最后,讨论了对计算语言学和AI/mediated知识系统的影响,提出了一种后符号化和后界面范式,自然语言在其中作为通信媒介、可执行规格、认知脚手架和分布式记忆结构同时运作。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: For several decades, Natural Language Processing (NLP) has primarily conceptualised language as an object of computation: a symbolic or statistical entity to be parsed, classified, translated, summarised, or generated Jurafsky and Martin (2009) ; Winograd (1972) . From symbolic systems to transformer architectures, the dominant paradigm has remained substantially stable: language is treated as information to be processed computationally.
blocks.zh: 数十年来,自然语言处理(NLP)主要将语言概念化为计算对象:一个要被解析,分类,翻译,总结,或生成的具有象征意义的或统计性质的实体Jurafsky和Martin(2009年);Winograd(1972年). 从象征性的系统到变压器架构,占主导地位的范式一直基本稳定:语言被当作信息进行计算处理.

blocks.en: Recent advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), challenge this assumption. While traditional NLP systems focused on recognizing or generating linguistic structures, LLM-based systems increasingly enable natural language to function as an operational medium through which humans formulate intentions, coordinate reasoning, and regulate interaction with computational systems. Language is therefore no longer merely processed: it becomes a vehicle for orchestrating cognitive workflows.
blocks.zh: 基因人工智能(GenAI),特别是大语言模型(LLMs)的近期进步,对这一假设提出了挑战. 虽然传统的NLP系统侧重于识别或生成语言结构,但基于LLM的系统越来越能够使自然语言作为一个操作媒介发挥作用,人类通过它来表达意图,协调推理,并调节与计算系统的互动. 因此,语言不再仅仅是处理的:它成为整理认知工作流程的工具。

blocks.en:
This transformation suggests a broader epistemological shift within computational linguistics. Interaction with LLMs increasingly resembles a form of cognitive orchestration in which prompts externalise goals, constraints, intermediate reasoning states, and reflective strategies Liu et al. (2022) ; Wei and others (2022) ; Brown et al. (2020) . Natural language may therefore operate as a mechanism for dynamically configuring hybrid human–AI cognitive systems.
This perspective also resonates with emerging Cyber Humanities approaches, which interpret generative AI not merely as a technological tool, but as a cognitive and cultural infrastructure reshaping human agency, knowledge mediation, and reflective interaction Adorni and Bellini (2025) .
blocks.zh:
这种转变暗示了计算语言学内部更广泛的认知转变. 与LLMS的互动越来越类似于一种认知协调形式,在这种形式中,促进外部化的目标、限制、中间推理状态和反射战略 Liu等人(2022年);Wei等人(2022年);Brown等人(2020年)。 因此,自然语言可以作为动态配置人类-AI认知系统的一种机制。
这种观点也与新兴的网络人文学科方法产生共鸣,将基因AI解读为不仅仅是一种技术工具,而是一种认知和文化基础设施,重塑了人类机构,知识调解,以及反射互动Adorni和Bellini(2025).

blocks.en: The limitations of the classical NLP paradigm become particularly evident when considering memory and context. Traditional architectures largely focused on sentence-level processing and probabilistic prediction, often treating context as an auxiliary parameter. By contrast, interaction with LLMs increasingly relies on persistent conversational states, iterative refinement, contextual reconstruction, and dialogic continuity, progressively acquiring characteristics associated with working memory and cognitive architectures.
blocks.zh: 在考虑记忆和上下文时,古典NLP范式的局限性变得特别明显. 传统架构主要侧重于句子级处理和概率预测,常将上下文作为辅助参数. 相比之下,与LLMS的互动越来越依赖于持续的对话状态,迭代的完善,背景的重建,以及对话的连续性,逐渐获得与工作记忆和认知架构相关的特征.

blocks.en: Theoretical perspectives from distributed cognition and philosophy of mind provide important tools for understanding this transition. Distributed cognition argues that cognitive processes emerge through interactions among agents, artefacts, and environments Hutchins (1995) , while the ”Extended Mind” thesis suggests that external artefacts may become integral components of cognition itself Clark and Chalmers (1998) . Within this framework, prompts, conversational traces, and interaction histories can be interpreted as forms of externalised working memory distributed across hybrid human–AI systems.
blocks.zh: 从分布式认知和心灵哲学的理论视角为理解这种转变提供了重要工具. 分布式认知认为,认知过程是通过物剂、手工艺品和环境Hutchins (1995年)之间的互动产生的,而“Extend Mind”的论文则表明,外部的手工艺品可能成为认知本身克拉克和Chalmers (1998年)的组成部分。 在这一框架内,提示、对话痕迹和互动历史可以被解释为在人类-AI混合系统中分布的外部化工作记忆形式。

blocks.en: At the same time, dialogic and socio-cultural perspectives emphasize that meaning emerges through situated interaction and co-construction processes rather than isolated symbolic manipulation Bakhtin (1981) ; Vygotsky and Kozulin (2012) . Prompting therefore increasingly resembles a dialogic process through which reasoning is stabilised, negotiated, and reconstructed across conversational exchanges.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,对话和社会文化观点强调,意义是通过定位互动和共同建设进程产生的,而不是孤立的象征性操纵Bakhtin(1981年);Vygotsky和Kozulin(2012年)。 因此,推动越来越类似于对话进程,通过对话交流,推理得到稳定、谈判和重建。

blocks.en:
Building on these premises, this paper introduces the concept of Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical extension of traditional NLP. Rather than treating language exclusively as an object of computation, NLPg conceptualizes prompts as executable cognitive artefacts through which humans externalise reasoning, maintain contextual continuity, and orchestrate hybrid cognitive workflows.
More specifically, we argue that prompts simultaneously operate as: • executable specifications, • cognitive artefacts, • metacognitive scaffolds, • and dialogic memory structures. To formalize this perspective, the paper proposes the notion of Dialogic Working Memory , describing how conversational interaction with LLMs supports the stabilization and reconstruction of distributed cognitive states.
blocks.zh:
基于这些前提,本文提出了自然语言编程(NLPg)的概念,作为传统NLP的理论延伸. NLPg不把语言完全当作一个计算对象,而是将提示概念化为可执行的认知手工艺品,人类通过它将推理外部化,保持背景连续性,并协调混合认知工作流程.
更具体地说,我们主张,“提示”同时作为:可执行的规格、认知手工艺品、元认知脚手架和对话记忆结构。 为了将这一视角正规化,本文提出了“对话工作记忆”的概念,描述了与LLMS的对话互动如何支持分布式认知状态的稳定和重建。

blocks.en: executable specifications,
blocks.zh: 可执行规格,

blocks.en: cognitive artefacts,
blocks.zh: 认知器械,

blocks.en: metacognitive scaffolds,
blocks.zh: 元认知脚手架,

blocks.en: and dialogic memory structures.
blocks.zh: 和对话框内存结构。

blocks.en: Recent research on prompting and conversational AI has primarily focused on prompt optimization, chain-of-thought reasoning, code generation, and interaction efficiency Wei and others (2022) ; Reeves et al. (2025) . Within this landscape, the term Natural Language Programming has often referred to the use of natural language for specifying computational tasks or generating executable code.
blocks.zh: 最近关于促动和对话AI的研究主要集中于即时优化,思维链推理,代码生成,以及互动效率的Wei等人(2022年);Reeves等人(2025年). 在这个景观中,自然语言编程一词经常指使用自然语言来指定计算任务或生成可执行代码.

blocks.en: Our proposal extends this perspective by interpreting NLPg as a distributed cognitive and dialogic memory architecture operating through conversational interaction rather than as a simple code-generation paradigm.
blocks.zh: 我们的提案通过将NLPg解释为通过对话互动运作的分布式认知和对话式记忆架构,而不是简单的代码生成范式来扩展这一视角.

blocks.en: Existing approaches such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation [12], In-Context Learning [5], and tool use [13] provide mechanisms for external memory, dynamic adaptation, and action coordination. Dialogic Working Memory can be interpreted as a higher-level orchestration layer that integrates and regulates these mechanisms within a conversational cognitive framework.
blocks.zh: 现有方法,如检索-增强生成[12],内文学习[5],以及工具使用[13],为外部内存,动态适应以及行动协调提供了机制. 对话工作记忆可以解释为更高层次的管弦乐层,在对话认知框架内整合和调节这些机制.

blocks.en: Unlike existing work primarily focused on prompt optimization or code generation, this paper conceptualizes NLPg as a distributed cognitive infrastructure in which prompts externalise reasoning processes, stabilize contextual continuity, and support reflective orchestration across hybrid human–AI systems.
blocks.zh: 与目前主要专注于即时优化或代码生成的工作不同,本文将NLPg概念化为分布式认知基础设施,在这种基础设施中,激发外部化推理过程,稳定背景连续性,并支持跨混合人类-AI系统的反射式管弦.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are: 1. A theoretical definition of NLPg as an extension of NLP toward language-mediated cognitive orchestration. 2. The proposal of Dialogic Working Memory , interpreting conversational interaction as a form of reconstructive distributed memory management. 3. A conceptual mapping of conversational memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto the NLPg framework. 4. A discussion of implications for computational linguistics, suggesting a transition toward cognitive mediation infrastructures rather than purely text-processing systems.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献是: 1. NLPg的理论定义是NLP向语言媒介认知管弦学的延伸. 2. “对话工作记忆”的建议,将对话互动解释为一种重建式分布式记忆管理。 3. 将对话记忆架构(BTMA,SKGE,RMR)的概念映射到NLPg框架上. 4. 讨论对计算语言学的影响,建议向认知调解基础设施而不是纯文本处理系统过渡。

blocks.zh: NLPg的理论定义是NLP向语言介质认知管弦学的延伸.

blocks.en: The proposal of Dialogic Working Memory , interpreting conversational interaction as a form of reconstructive distributed memory management.
blocks.zh: Dialogic Work Memory 的建议,将对话交互解释为一种重建式分布式内存管理形式.

blocks.en: A conceptual mapping of conversational memory architectures (BTMA, SKGE, RMR) onto the NLPg framework.
blocks.zh: 将对话记忆架构(BTMA,SKGE,RMR)的概念映射到NLPg框架上.

blocks.en: A discussion of implications for computational linguistics, suggesting a transition toward cognitive mediation infrastructures rather than purely text-processing systems.
blocks.zh: 讨论对计算语言学的影响,建议向认知调解基础设施而不是纯文本处理系统过渡。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is organised as follows. Section 2 discusses the transition from NLP to NLPg. Section 3 introduces prompting as cognitive programming. Section 4 presents the Dialogic Working Memory framework. Section 5 examines NLPg as a metacognitive scaffold. Section 6 discusses implications for computational linguistics, and Section 7 concludes with limitations and future directions.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第2节讨论从NLP到NLPg的过渡. 第3节将“提示”作为认知编程。 第4节介绍了对话工作记忆框架。 第5节审查NLPg作为元识别脚手架. 第6节讨论了对计算语言学的影响,第7节最后提出了限制和未来的方向。

blocks.en: 2 From NLP to NLPg: Processing vs. Orchestration
blocks.zh: 2 从 NLP 到 NLPg: 处理与管弦乐

blocks.en:
The emergence of LLMs is transforming not only the technological
landscape of NLP, but also the assumptions underlying the relationship
between language, cognition, and computation. While traditional NLP
primarily treated language as an object of computational analysis,
interaction with generative models increasingly positions natural
language as a medium for orchestrating cognitive processes and
configuring hybrid human–AI workflows.

blocks.en: 3 Prompting as Cognitive Programming
blocks.zh: 3 作为认知方案拟订的提示

blocks.en:
The widespread adoption of LLMs has transformed prompting from a
marginal interaction mechanism into a central cognitive practice.
Prompts are no longer simple textual queries, but structured artefacts
through which users externalise intentions, organise reasoning,
regulate context, and coordinate iterative problem solving.
blocks.zh:
广泛采用法学硕士学位,已经从
边际互动机制成为中心认知实践.
提示不再是简单的文字查询,而是结构化的手工艺品
用户将意图外部化,组织推理,
规范上下文,协调迭代问题的解决。

blocks.en:
Prompting should therefore not be interpreted merely as query
optimization or interaction technique. Rather, it increasingly
resembles a form of cognitive programming , in which natural
language configures reasoning spaces and coordinates distributed
cognitive processes across conversational interaction.
blocks.zh:
因此,不应仅仅将提示解释为查询
优化或互动技术。 相反,它越来越
类似于一种认知编程形式,其中自然
语言配置推理空间和分布的坐标
跨越对话互动的认知过程.

blocks.en:
Unlike traditional programming languages, which rely on rigid syntax
and deterministic execution, prompting operates through flexible and
context-sensitive interaction. Yet prompts increasingly exhibit
functional characteristics analogous to programming abstractions,
including task decomposition, goal specification, constraint
definition, validation procedures, and iterative refinement.

定义、验证程序和迭代改进。

blocks.en:
This becomes particularly evident in advanced prompting strategies such
as chain-of-thought, reflective prompting, and multi-step workflows.
In these contexts, prompts do not simply request information; they
structure the cognitive trajectory through which reasoning is
generated, evaluated, and progressively refined.

The notion of cognitive artefact Norman (1993) provides a
theoretical foundation. Norman defines cognitive artefacts as
artificial structures designed to maintain, display, or manipulate
information in support of cognitive activity. Distributed cognition
theories further argue that cognition emerges through interactions
among agents, tools, and representations rather than remaining confined
within the individual mind Hutchins (1995) .

blocks.en: 4 Memory Architectures
blocks.zh: 4 内存结构

blocks.en:
The transition from NLP to NLPg requires a corresponding rethinking of memory.
In classical NLP systems, memory is generally treated either as a static repository of linguistic representations or as a transient computational buffer supporting inference and generation. By contrast, interaction with Large Language Models increasingly exhibits characteristics of distributed, reconstructive, and dialogically mediated memory processes.
blocks.zh:
从NLP到NLPg的过渡需要对内存进行相应的反思.
在古典的NLP系统中,记忆一般被作为语言表达的静态寄存器或作为瞬态计算缓冲支持推论和生成. 相比之下,与大语言模型的互动越来越多地展示分布式、重建式和对话式的内存过程的特点。

blocks.en:
In NLPg, language no longer functions exclusively as an object of
computation. Instead, it progressively operates as a mechanism for
stabilizing contextual continuity across conversational interaction.
Prompts, summaries, retrieved traces, and conversational histories
collectively behave as distributed memory structures supporting
reasoning continuity across time.

The concept of working memory traditionally refers to the temporary

It emerges dynamically through

Conversational interaction with LLMs therefore increasingly behaves as

A key implication of these architectures is that memory in NLPg is not

blocks.en: 5 NLPg as Metacognitive Scaffold
blocks.zh: 5 NLPg 作为元识别脚手架

blocks.en:
Natural Language Programming (NLPg) redefines the relationship between
language, cognition, and learning. Prompting practices increasingly
function as metacognitive scaffolds supporting planning, monitoring,
reflection, and adaptive revision during problem-solving activities.
Unlike traditional interfaces designed for command execution,
LLM-mediated interaction supports iterative reasoning in which language
itself becomes a medium for organising thought. Prompts externalise
reasoning strategies and preserve intermediate conceptual states across
interaction cycles.

自然语言编程( NLPg) 重新定义关系

blocks.en:
Prompt-Based Learning (PBL) frames prompting as a reflective process
through which learners iteratively construct, evaluate, and refine
reasoning strategies Adorni et al. (2026) ; Reeves et al. (2025) .
Within this perspective, prompts function simultaneously as cognitive
organisers, external reasoning traces, metacognitive checkpoints, and
dialogic learning artefacts. The educational relevance lies in the
visibility of reasoning processes. Unlike traditional systems, NLPg
externalises substantial portions of reasoning through conversational
traces, supporting metacognitive awareness by enabling learners to
inspect strategies, revise assumptions, and identify inconsistencies.
Prompting therefore becomes not only a means of obtaining outputs, but
also a mechanism for organising reflective learning.

因此,促动不仅成为获得产出的手段,而且成为获得产出的手段。
也是组织反思学习的机制。

blocks.en:
A key consequence of NLPg is the progressive traceability of reasoning
processes. Conversational traces document prompt evolution,
intermediate reasoning steps, decomposition strategies, revisions,
validation attempts, and reflective corrections. These traces
constitute epistemic artefacts : externalised representations of
evolving cognitive processes. Metacognitive regulation includes
planning, monitoring, evaluation, and adaptive revision Schraw and Dennison (1994) ; Panadero (2017) . NLPg environments support these
mechanisms through recursive conversational workflows involving problem
formulation, decomposition, generation, validation, revision, and
re-generation. This transforms prompting into a form of dialogic
reflective regulation in which reasoning is progressively
co-constructed.
blocks.zh:

进程。 对话跟踪文档 快速进化,

规划、监测、评价和适应性修订Schraw和Dennison(1994);Panadero(2017)。 NLPg 环境支持这些

重新生成。 将导出为对话形式

blocks.en:
Within this framework, prompts behave similarly to metacognitive
operators: they activate reasoning procedures, constrain solution
spaces, establish evaluation criteria, and regulate conversational
direction. Reflective regulation is distributed across both human and
computational agents. The LLM contributes generative capabilities,
while the human performs epistemic supervision and contextual
validation. Traceability also introduces cognitive accountability.
Since reasoning remains partially externalised, users are encouraged to justify decisions and critically evaluate outputs rather than passively accepting them. This becomes particularly significant in the presence of hallucinations, semantic drift, and contextual inconsistencies in generative AI Grosso (2026b) .
Conversational traceability supports validation by making reasoning trajectories inspectable and revisable.
blocks.zh:
在这一框架内,促使人们采取类似行为来认识
运算符:它们激活推理程序,约束解决方案

审定。 可追踪性还引入了认知问责制。
由于推理仍然部分外在化,鼓励用户为决策提供理由,严格评价产出,而不是被动接受产出。 这一点在出现幻觉、语义漂移和在遗传性AI Grosso(2026年b)中出现背景不一致时变得尤为重要。
争议可追溯性通过使推理轨迹可检查和可重视支持验证.

blocks.en:
Finally, NLPg enables the externalisation of metacognitive activity itself. Prompts, revisions, clarifications, and validation cycles form visible representations of cognitive regulation processes supporting reflective learning, collaborative reasoning, process-oriented assessment, and AI literacy development. However, this transformation also introduces risks. Externalisation may encourage over-reliance on conversational scaffolds, excessive delegation of reasoning, or superficial validation practices. Consequently, NLPg requires forms of reflective AI literacy capable of preserving human epistemic agency and critical cognitive autonomy within AI-mediated environments.
This concern aligns with Cyber Humanities perspectives emphasizing the need to preserve reflective human agency and critical autonomy within AI-mediated cognitive ecosystems Adorni and Bellini (2025) .
The central problem is no longer whether AI systems generate correct outputs, but whether users maintain the capacity to critically regulate and validate distributed reasoning processes. NLPg therefore repositions language from a medium for information exchange to a mechanism for orchestrating metacognitive activity across hybrid human–AI systems.
blocks.zh:
最后,NLPg使元认知活动本身能够外部化. 提示、修订、澄清和验证周期构成了认知调控过程的明显表现,支持反射学习、协作推理、面向进程的评估和AI识字发展。 然而,这种转变也带来了风险。 外部化可能鼓励过度依赖对话脚手架、过度授权推理或表面验证做法。 因此,NLPg需要能够保留人类感知机构和AI介导环境中的关键认知自主的反射AI识字形式.
这一关注与网络人文学观点一致,强调在AI媒介的认知生态系统Adorni和Bellini(2025年)内必须保持反映性的人机和关键自主性。
中心问题不再在于AI系统是否产生正确的输出,而是用户是否保持严格调节和验证分布式推理过程的能力. 因此,NLPg将语言从信息交流媒介重新定位为跨越人类-AI混合系统协调元认知活动的机制。

blocks.en: 6 Implications for Computational Linguistics
blocks.zh: 6. 对计算语言学的影响

blocks.en:
The emergence of NLPg challenges several foundational assumptions of computational linguistics. If natural
language increasingly functions not only as an object of computation but also as an operational cognitive medium, then the role of language technologies must be reconsidered.
blocks.zh:
NLPg的出现挑战了计算语言学的几个基础假设. 如果自然的话
语言不仅作为计算的对象,而且作为可操作的认知媒介,其功能日益增强,因此必须重新考虑语言技术的作用。

blocks.en:
For decades, computational linguistics has primarily focused on
language understanding, generation, semantic representation, and
syntactic parsing. Even transformer architectures largely remained within this paradigm Jurafsky and Martin (2009) . By contrast, LLM-mediated interaction suggests a different perspective in which natural language operates not simply as representational input, but as a mechanism for orchestrating reasoning, maintaining contextual continuity, coordinating human–AI workflows, and regulating reflective interaction.
blocks.zh:
几十年来,计算语言学主要侧重于
语言理解、生成、语义表达和
综合剖析. 甚至变压器的建筑也基本上仍然在这个范式中, 相比之下,LLM介导的相互作用则提出不同的观点,自然语言不仅作为代表性输入,而是作为协调推理、保持环境连续性、协调人与AI工作流程以及调节反射互动的机制。

blocks.en: This transformation shifts computational linguistics toward cognitive mediation infrastructures : systems that do not merely process linguistic content, but actively participate in the stabilization and reconstruction of distributed cognitive processes.
blocks.zh: 这种转变将计算语言学转向认知调解基础设施:系统不仅处理语言内容,而且积极参与分布式认知过程的稳定和重建。

blocks.en:
The rise of LLM-based systems introduces a conversational turn within computational linguistics. Historically, NLP has primarily
focused on sentence- or document-level processing, while dialogue
systems often treated conversation as sequential information exchange.
By contrast, NLPg frames conversation as a cognitive process, memory
mechanism, reflective structure, and coordination protocol.
Conversational interaction supports contextual stabilization,
iterative reinterpretation, semantic negotiation, and collaborative
reasoning.

blocks.en:
This perspective explains the growing relevance of long-horizon
consistency, memory persistence, referential stability, behavioral
coherence, and metacognitive traceability. These phenomena cannot be
fully understood through traditional text-processing paradigms because
they emerge at the level of distributed interaction.

blocks.en:
Recent work on conversational memory architectures and CDOS phenomena suggests that contextual degradation may affect not only output quality, but cognitive continuity itself Grosso (2026b) . Semantic drift, referential
instability, and behavioral inconsistency increasingly represent
disruptions in cognitive mediation rather than simple generation
errors.

blocks.en:
The implications of NLPg extend beyond technical architecture toward a
broader epistemological transition. Classical symbolic AI relied on
explicit formal representations and deterministic execution rules,
while contemporary NLP largely replaced symbolic reasoning with
probabilistic modeling. Yet both paradigms preserved a distinction
between user, interface, command, and computational execution.
blocks.zh:
NLPg的影响超越了技术结构,走向
更广泛的流行病学转变。 典型的象征意义
明确正式陈述和决定处决规则,
当代 NLP 基本取代了符号推理
概率模型学. 但两种模式都保持了区别
在用户,界面,命令,和计算执行之间.

blocks.en:
NLPg partially dissolves these distinctions. In conversational systems,
language acts simultaneously as representation and execution; prompts
function as communication and cognitive regulation; conversational
traces operate as both interaction history and distributed memory.
Natural language increasingly becomes the operational substrate through
which cognition is coordinated.
blocks.zh:
NLPg 部分解析这些区分. 在谈话系统中,
语言同时作为代表和执行; 提示
作为交流和认知调节的功能; 对话
痕迹既是交互历史,又是分布式记忆。
自然语言日益成为可操作的底物
与认知相协调。

blocks.en:
This transformation does not imply the disappearance of formal
computation. Rather, computational processes become progressively
embedded within conversational and context-dependent cognitive
ecologies mediated by natural language. Language technologies are no
longer interpreted solely as systems for understanding or generating
text, but as infrastructures for coordinating cognition, stabilizing
memory, supporting distributed agency, externalizing reasoning, and
mediating reflective interaction across hybrid human–AI systems.

blocks.en:
NLPg therefore represents not simply a new interaction paradigm, but a
broader reconfiguration of the relationship between language,
cognition, memory, and computation. Traditional NLP tasks such as
parsing, semantic modeling, information extraction, and generation
remain fundamental, but increasingly operate within conversational
ecologies in which natural language functions not only as
representational content, but also as a mechanism for cognitive
coordination and contextual orchestration.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
The emergence of Large Language Models is transforming the role of
natural language within computational systems. Throughout the history
of NLP, language has primarily been interpreted as an object of
computation. This paper argued that generative AI introduces a broader
epistemological shift in which natural language increasingly functions
as an executable cognitive medium supporting reasoning, memory
externalization, reflective regulation, and hybrid human–AI interaction.

blocks.en:
Building on this transformation, we introduced the concept of Natural Language Programming (NLPg) as a theoretical extension
of traditional NLP. Unlike classical language-processing paradigms,
NLPg conceptualizes prompts and conversational interaction as
operational cognitive structures capable of stabilizing contextual
continuity, organizing distributed memory, and supporting
metacognitive regulation. Within this framework, prompts operate as
executable intentions, cognitive artefacts, dialogic memory traces,
and reflective scaffolds.

和反射的脚手架。

blocks.en:
We further proposed the notion of Dialogic Working Memory to
describe how conversational interaction with LLMs externalises
temporary cognitive states across distributed human–AI systems.
Integrating perspectives from distributed cognition, working memory
theory, and dialogic interaction, the framework interprets
conversational exchange as a process of contextual reconstruction and
cognitive orchestration.

Recent architectures such as BTMA, SKGE, and RMR suggest that
LLM-mediated systems are already evolving toward structured forms of
distributed memory management and metacognitive stabilization Grosso (2026a) ; Grosso (2026c) . At the same time, phenomena such
as Cost-Driven Output Substitution (CDOS) highlight how conversational

blocks.en:
From this perspective, computational linguistics can no longer be
interpreted exclusively as the study of language understanding or text
generation. Language technologies increasingly function as cognitive
mediation infrastructures supporting distributed reasoning, memory
reconstruction, and reflective coordination across hybrid human–AI
systems. This transformation suggests the gradual emergence of a
post-symbolic and post-interface paradigm in which the distinction
between language, memory, interface, and execution progressively
blurs.

blocks.en:
The proposed framework remains primarily theoretical and conceptual, and should be interpreted as an epistemological model intended to support future empirical and architectural research. Although primarily conceptual, the framework emerged from ongoing experimental work on conversational memory architectures and AI-mediated educational environments.
Dialogic Working Memory and conversational orchestration therefore require further formal modeling and experimental validation.
blocks.zh:
拟议的框架仍然主要是理论和概念性的,应被解释为一种旨在支持未来经验和建筑研究的认知模式。 该框架虽然主要是概念性的,但产生于关于对话记忆架构和AI调解教育环境的持续实验工作。
因此,对谈性的工作记忆和对话性安排需要进一步正式的建模和实验验证。

blocks.en:
Future research may explore:
(i) conversational memory persistence and long-horizon consistency;
(ii) metacognitive traceability in human–AI interaction;
(iii) educational applications of NLPg within reflective learning
environments; and
(iv) conversational infrastructures capable of preserving human
epistemic agency while leveraging LLM capabilities.

More broadly, the transition from Natural Language Processing to
Natural Language Programming may represent not simply a technological
evolution, but a deeper transformation in how language itself is
understood within the relationship between humans, cognition, and
computation.
Within this perspective, NLPg may also contribute to the broader Cyber Humanities agenda aimed at rethinking human-centered cognition, education, and cultural mediation in the age of generative AI.
